_comment: Mechanical checks, so REVIEW.md never has to ask about them (docs/trust.md, principle: mechanical vs judgment). The `[ -f package.json ] || exit 0` guards are no-ops once slice 1 lands; before that they keep a code-less repo from failing every session. A Stop hook only blocks finishing when it exits 2, hence `|| exit 2`. If `pnpm check` ever passes ~10s, move tests to /vet and pre-push and leave format/lint/typecheck here.

hooks.command: sed -n '/^## Current goal/,/^## /p' ROADMAP.md | sed '$d'; echo; tail -n 5 DECISIONS.md
[ -f package.json ] || exit 0; jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | xargs pnpm exec prettier --write --log-level silent
